title: Lower-level apartment w 2 BRs and kitchenette
description:
This remodeled apartment is the lower half of our  home.  We're located about 17 miles  from Broadway/Downtown in a wooded subdivision.  We're 1/2 mile from a large shopping area with restaurants, grocery stores, ice rink, large theatre, and hotel.  
You will enter through our front door and go down 4 stairs into your unit with a well-insulated locked door.  It's soundproof; you may only hear my footsteps during the day when I am working from home.  
Welcome to our beloved oasis!

The space
There are 2 bedrooms, one with a king bed and one with a queen.  The room with a queen bed has a reading nook, too!  The living area and kitchenette are in one big room with a dining table for 4.  We love pop art and have a few pieces in the unit.  The bathroom was just remodeled in 2022 and features a large stand up shower and white tile.
